hero.title: Community
hero.subtitle: Zylo Office is a young, proprietary product: we don't have a public forum or a developer community (yet). What we're building is a direct relationship with our first customers — and your feedback matters more than ever at this stage.

feedback.title: Share your feedback
feedback.body: As an early customer, your input directly shapes what comes next for Zylo Liquid and Zylo Tanker. Tell us what works, what's missing, and what would save you time.

updates.title: Follow the news
updates.description: A newsletter and a changelog are coming. In the meantime, contact us directly to be notified of upcoming updates.

partner.title: Become a partner
partner.body: Do you support fuel stations or transport fleets and want to explore a partnership with Zylo Office? Let's talk.
